tasks.short: Read appliance prescriptions and determine fabrication requirements

steps.what: Find and verify the correct current prescription or specification for the actual device case
inputs: Actual device case identifier
Prescriber-produced prescription and authorized specifications in the appliance workshop system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Correct current source documents with unresolved identity or version issues marked

steps.what: Read the actual prescription or specifications to understand the required type of product or device
inputs: Verified prescription and specifications from s1
outputs: Technician's understanding of device requirements and ambiguities

steps.what: Determine the device type, fabrication materials and tools required, clarifying uncertain requirements with the responsible clinician
inputs: Actual source requirements and ambiguities from s2
Established workshop and clinical direction
outputs: Human-determined fabrication requirements or a hold pending clarification

tasks.design: Configure native case and version lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. The technician reads the actual prescription and determines fabrication requirements, with uncertain clinical intent referred to its owner.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current prescription can involve repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links can expose existing controlled documents.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical intent and fabrication feasibility require qualified interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when requirements need clarification before making a device.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case-linked document access can reduce navigation while prescription interpretation and device requirements remain human work.

assumptions: Conditional manual-navigation episode, not a measured baseline. Prescribers and authorized specification owners produce source documents; technician retrieval and version checks remain in s1.
Native features first; existing equivalent links earn no new saving. Missing documents or conflicting instructions stop interpretation for clarification; no generated device specification.

No separate fabrication order write, clinical approval or machine command is established by this reading task. If an actual controlled instruction is authored or released, its writing, complete final check and separate gated action must be added rather than silently omitted.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross lookup saving 2 less upkeep 0.5 gives net 1.5. Shared requirement determination with a parts-order episode is counted once.
unknowns: Actual prescription access and current case-link coverage
research_questions: Which prescription navigation remains manual after existing workshop features?

already_counted.description: Retained source retrieval and identity/version checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional lookup saving 2 less upkeep 0.5; prescription reading and requirement decisions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order parts and supplies for orthotic or prosthetic devices

steps.what: Identify actual required parts or supplies and capture exact identifiers, quantities and device compatibility constraints
inputs: Actual authorized device specification or stock need
Existing workshop and parts records, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Technician-authored structured requirement with explicit identifiers and quantities

steps.what: Find and verify supplier part matches, current availability, prices and delivery terms
inputs: Actual part requirements from s1
Supplier-maintained catalogue and commercial records
outputs: Checked exact supplier matches and explicit unresolved alternatives

steps.what: Stage confirmed exact part lines and quantities into the native draft order
inputs: Structured requirement captured in s1
Exact supplier matches checked in s2
outputs: Traceable staged draft order with unmatched lines held

steps.what: Resolve compatibility or purchasing exceptions and complete and check the exact final supplier order and matching internal record
inputs: Draft order
Original requirements and current commercial evidence
outputs: Complete checked order and matching internal order record

steps.what: Submit the exact checked parts or supplies order to the supplier
inputs: Exact final order checked in s4
outputs: Submitted supplier order and actual submission outcome

steps.what: Save the exact checked internal order record with the actual submission status
inputs: Exact matching record checked in s4
Actual submission status from s5

tasks.design: Use native {PARTNER_PORTAL} lookup and exact-field draft-order imports from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The technician retains compatibility and supplier decisions and checks both complete artefacts before separately submitting the order and saving its internal record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated supplier navigation and transferring exact part lines can duplicate work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters and structured draft-order import can preserve exact confirmed identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical specification changes and compatible substitutions require qualified human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a purchasing choice changes the prescribed device and obtain the responsible clinician's decision.

ambition.what: Improve existing parts and supplies ordering.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supplier catalogue filters and draft-order imports can reduce exact-line transfer while compatibility and purchasing choices remain human.

assumptions: Conditional manual-transfer order episode, not a measured baseline. Specification owners produce authorized requirements; technician exact-field capture is counted in s1 and supplier evidence checking in s2.
Native features first. Missing matches and proposed substitutes remain in s4; no automated clinical equivalence or device change. Existing imports earn no new saving.

Assumes actual delegated purchasing authority for the unchanged specified parts. Any required purchasing or clinical owner must review the exact completed final order or specification change before submission, with their labour added.
The internal save is negligible and fully retained; submission also earns no saving. Delivery, receipt and payment are separate work, with no hidden automated commitments.
If the existing portal already creates the internal record, do not invent duplicate transfer. Deduplicate requirement work shared with 10514.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross lookup saving 5 plus import saving 25 equals 30, less upkeep 3 gives net 27.
unknowns: Current order imports and authority for device-specific purchases
research_questions: Which exact part lines are still manually transferred after current supplier tools?

already_counted.description: Requirement capture, retained supplier lookup/checking and complete final compatibility and order review

incremental.description: Maintain exact part-field mappings and validate draft-order imports

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete supplier order checked in s4; item, quantity, price or term changes require recheck
Exact matching internal record checked in s4 with actual submission status only

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual lookup and exact-line transfer saving 30 less upkeep 3; no saving for existing equivalent ordering automation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct patients in prosthetic or orthotic device use

steps.what: Find and check the actual prescribed device instructions and relevant patient context
inputs: Actual device and patient case in the appliance workshop system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
Existing authorized device-use information
outputs: Checked instruction source and patient context

steps.what: Instruct the patient in actual prosthetic or orthotic device use, demonstrate established instructions and observe the patient's understanding and practice
inputs: Actual patient and prescribed device
Checked authorized instructions
outputs: Actual patient instruction, observed practice and unresolved questions

steps.what: Capture the actual required instruction record after the session and check its complete wording, observed practice and unresolved questions
inputs: Actual instruction and observed patient practice from s2
outputs: Complete checked instruction record describing actual participation and limitations

steps.what: Save the exact checked patient-instruction record
inputs: Exact complete record checked in s3

tasks.design: Configure existing {DOCS} instruction links and fixed patient/device fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The technician instructs the patient and captures and checks the actual session record before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct instruction source and repeating identifiers can consume some session administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case-linked sources and forms can reduce navigation and fixed-field entry.
tasks.still_hard: Patient comfort, actual use and understanding require in-person attention.
tasks.human_edge: Notice difficulties and adapt the explanation within authorized instructions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source links and fixed case fields can support device-instruction records while demonstration and observed patient practice remain human.

assumptions: Conditional instruction episode with an actual required record, not invented notes after every conversation. Authorized owners produce source instructions; technician source checks and actual observation capture are counted in s1-s3.
Native features first; existing equivalent links and fields earn zero saving. s3 reduces identifiers only, retaining actual session wording and the complete check.

Record completion only follows actual instruction and observed practice in s2; no inferred attendance, competence or successful device use. Unresolved clinical concerns remain with the responsible clinician.
No generated device-use procedure, adjustment command or additional patient message. Saving is negligible and fully retained.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 2 plus 0.9 equals 2.9, less upkeep 1 gives net 1.9.
unknowns: Actual instruction-record requirements and source-link coverage
research_questions: Which source lookup and fixed-field entry remain manual during actual patient-instruction sessions?

already_counted.description: Retained source checks and actual post-session capture and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain authorized instruction links and fixed record fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete post-session record checked in s3; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional source lookup and identifier saving 2.9 less upkeep 1; actual patient instruction and record meaning retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Maintain exact part and device identifiers
Configure native source and order fields
role.ambitious_version: The technician uses native tools for demonstrably repeated information handling while retaining prescription interpretation, parts compatibility and patient instruction.
